$comment: The commands whose GUI location belongs to a checkpoint that has not passed (rulings D-30, D-31): the owner checkpoint, the spec section that defines the location, and the location. The parity gate (crates/executor/tests/c43/parity.rs) requires every implemented command to be bound in parity.json, declared agent-only, or listed here, and exactly one of the three; an owner must not have passed.
